ARC-Managed Smartstrap Attribute Handle & Service API

Unique-ownership wrapper for SmartstrapAttribute objects used for reading/writing accessory attributes, plus general service management.

Imports

../ffi, ../ffi/managed

Types

SmartstrapAttributeHandle = object
Unique ownership handle for RawType.
